violations.detail: Plan promises "hypertrophy" but duration is 2wk — that adaptation is not physiologically deliverable in this window.

raw_text:
PLAN "Travel Maintenance - Hotel Room"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary maintenance:
    name "Hold hypertrophy base during two-week travel"

PHASES
  PHASE "Travel Maintenance" (2 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Upper Push and Pull":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          arm_circles 1m
          shoulder_stretch 1m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          chin_up 3x5..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x40 seconds rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1m
          lat_stretch 1m
      DAY Tuesday training 35m "Lower Body":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          leg_swings 1m
          hip_circles 1m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15..20 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
          pigeon_pose 1m
      DAY Thursday training 35m "Upper Pull and Core":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          arm_circles 1m
          scapular_retraction 1m
        main straight_sets:
          chin_up 3x5..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 1m
          child_pose 1m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Full Lower and Core":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          hip_circles 1m
          leg_swings 1m
        main straight_sets:
          reverse_lunge 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x20..30 seconds rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          superman 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 1m
          quad_stretch 1m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Upper Push and Pull":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          arm_circles 1m
          shoulder_stretch 1m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          chin_up 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x45 seconds rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1m
          lat_stretch 1m
      DAY Tuesday training 35m "Lower Body":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          leg_swings 1m
          hip_circles 1m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x15..20 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15..20 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
          butterfly_stretch 1m
      DAY Thursday training 35m "Upper Pull and Core":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          arm_circles 1m
          scapular_retraction 1m
        main straight_sets:
          chin_up 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          push_up 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 1m
          child_pose 1m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Full Lower and Core":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          hip_circles 1m
          leg_swings 1m
        main straight_sets:
          reverse_lunge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x15..20 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x30..40 seconds rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          superman 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 1m
          quad_stretch 1m
